name: University of Louisville
tuition_note: In-state undergraduate tuition (tuition only, full-time 12+ credit hours) $6,695/semester = $13,390/year from Bursar page (student.louisville.edu/office-bursar) for Fall 2025/Spring 2026/Summer 2026; mandatory fees not included in this figure per the page. Housing: room-only rate for a standard Double at Belknap Village North/South $3,986/semester = $7,972/year (representative standard double) from housing costs-living page (louisville.edu/housing/living-campus/costs-living), projected 2026-2027 pending Board of Trustees approval; rates exclude meals and parking. Room-only rates range from $3,337/sem (Louisville Hall Double) to higher deluxe/apartment options.
